question: Which of the following churches is NOT located in Goa?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Santa Cruz Basilica**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Santa Cruz Basilica** is located in **Fort Kochi, Kerala**, not in Goa.
 
• It is one of the **oldest churches** in India, originally built by the Portuguese in 1505.
 
• The church was elevated to a cathedral by Pope Paul IV in 1558 and later proclaimed a basilica by Pope John Paul II in 1984.
 
• Santa Cruz Basilica is renowned for its stunning architecture and beautiful interior decorations.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Reis Magos Church:**

 
 
• Located in the village of Reis Magos, Bardez, Goa.
 
• Built in 1555, it is one of the oldest churches in Goa.
 
 
 
• **Mae De Deus Church:**
 
 
• Located in Saligao, Goa.
 
• Known for its Neo-Gothic architecture and the statue of Mae De Deus (Mother of God).
 
 
 
• **Basilica of Bom Jesus:**
 
 
• Located in Old Goa, it is a UNESCO World Heritage Site.
 
• Houses the mortal remains of St. Francis Xavier.
 
 
 
• **Church Architecture in Goa:**
 
 
• Goan churches often display a blend of Indian and Portuguese architectural styles.
 
• Many churches in Goa have been recognized as UNESCO World Heritage Sites.
